name: Editorial Magazine Split
summary: Asymmetric 60/40 warm-cream magazine spread pairing calm prose (65ch max measure), framed pull quotes, and measured geometric canvas plates.
spatialGrammar: Two asymmetric columns on --bg-editorial with generous breathing room, capped prose measure (65ch), hairline dividers, and optional PaperTearDivider transitions.
avoidWhen: Dense multi-metric comparisons or technical specification grids
responsiveBehavior: Stacks cleanly into a single vertical reading column below 768px with prose leading the visual plate.
exampleCode:
import { EditorialEssaySplit } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<EditorialEssaySplit
  heading="Warm editorial authority without photographic crutches."
  body="Millar pairs calibrated proportion with high-contrast Warm Sand typography."
  quote="Every axis is calibrated before code ships."
  quoteAttribution="Millar Visual Philosophy"
/>

name: Spatial Product Stage
summary: Deep Espresso showcase stage elevating crisp, interactive stylized Hahlex UI chrome with optional approved WarmHorizonWash lighting.
spatialGrammar: Full-bleed or framed --bg-stage-dark container anchoring live stylized ProductWindowFrame chrome and interactive view switchers with zero empty scroll traps.
avoidWhen: Long-form reading essays or FAQ blocks
responsiveBehavior: Two-column hero collapses to stacked headline -> CTA -> full-width stage frame below 768px; showcase tabs flex-wrap cleanly.
exampleCode:
import { ProductStageShowcase } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<ProductStageShowcase heading="Live stylized product chrome, never blank scroll boxes" />

name: Architectural Visible-Rule Grid
summary: Hairline 1px Warm Sand coordinate frame with corner registration crosshairs and structured technical specification cells.
spatialGrammar: Shared outer 1px border frame (CoordinateGridSurface) divided by crisp internal hairlines and monospaced technical codes (used strictly for real spec identifiers, never decorative costume).
avoidWhen: Emotional storytelling or repeating across consecutive sections
responsiveBehavior: Reflows cleanly from 2-column hairline matrix on desktop to single-column divided stack on mobile.
exampleCode:
import { ArchitectureGridSection } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<ArchitectureGridSection heading="Engineered for multi-product scale" />

name: Narrative Sequence Flow
summary: Continuous directional workflow sequence presenting ordered steps in collision-free cells with interactive state inspection.
spatialGrammar: Ordered <ol> grid of bounded step plates on --bg-stage-dark-deep connected by explicit directional markers and active border emphasis.
avoidWhen: Unordered feature lists where sequence carries no meaning
responsiveBehavior: Adapts seamlessly via auto-fit grid down to a legible single-column vertical rail on phones (never hiding step labels).
exampleCode:
import { WorkflowLoopSection } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<WorkflowLoopSection heading="Continuous design-to-agent governance loop" />

name: Monumental Typographic Poster & Metric Mirror
summary: Oversized Geist 300 display statements anchored by tabular-numeral MetricMirror strips and structured Before/After evidence ledgers.
spatialGrammar: Monumental single-column display headline (clamp 2.5rem-4.5rem) separated by a crisp 1px horizontal rule from an asymmetric lead + tabular <dl> metric bar.
responsiveBehavior: Fluid clamp typography scales down cleanly without overflow; metric strip stacks below lead copy on narrow viewports.
exampleCode:
import { HeroTypographicPoster } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<HeroTypographicPoster
  headline="Design systems should enforce craft, not write essays about it."
  lead="One W3C DTCG 2025.10 source compiled into Portal, packages, and MCP."
  ctaLabel="Read Architecture"
/>

name: Asymmetric Bento Mosaic
summary: Multi-scale asymmetric narrative mosaic combining orbital diagrams, stylized assistant threads, dot-matrix plates, and KPI callouts.
spatialGrammar: Two varied vertical columns pairing distinct visual heights (diagram + metric plate opposite thread preview + dark dot-matrix plate), deliberately rejecting equal 3-column icon-card grids.
responsiveBehavior: Collapses into a balanced single-column vertical flow below 640px preserving visual variety.
exampleCode:
import { BentoNarrativeMosaic } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<BentoNarrativeMosaic
  heading="Built for designers, engineers, and AI agents"
  lead="Every asset carries live code, responsive behavior, and MCP metadata."
/>
